change: Match normal floating geometry to Arc and retain sidebar width through quick drags, native popup placement, and double-click reset

arcReference.scope: Read-only arm64 trace; normal window with no home/fullscreen layout transform
arcReference.caller: 0x100219130 reads current presentation and effectiveSidebarWidth, calls 0x100219424 at 0x100219260
arcReference.frameConsumer: 0x100218a18 calls current layout, loads its first CGRect at 0x100218ae0..0x100218aec and sets floatingSidebarContainerView frame at 0x100218b28

implementation.floatingSpacing: Opt-in controller uses --zen-compact-float:10px; existing compact layout divides it by two for the outer inset
implementation.resize: Measure logical sidebar width once at drag start, excluding actual compact padding; clamp and store logical width; apply pending last move before release; avoid re-reading a native popup frame that may still reflect the previous width
implementation.doubleClick: Reset inline width, --zen-sidebar-width and persisted width together; dispatch resize event

editor.sidebarDragOutsideEditor: Dismisses expanded editor under existing outside-click policy; original input and controller retained

regressions: Candidate geometry 9 dropped a quick drag before its pending animation frame ran; geometry 10 commits the final pointer position
Old compact subtraction assumed twice the page separation, even when actual floating padding differed
Final width measurement could overwrite the requested width with the native popup’s previous frame
Double-click previously left the floating width CSS variable unchanged
limits: Normal floating outer frame is traced and measured; home/fullscreen geometry and complete control placement parity remain unverified
Right-side layout and resize are Zen compatibility checks, not an observed Arc right-sidebar comparison
Resizing behavior checks do not verify tab dragging, drag-to-collapse hints or the complete Arc resize policy
CUA can omit separate popup windows; these results do not establish composed Arc pixel parity
Automatic hover timing, material transition integration and screen-reader interaction remain unverified
Window draft/Undo measurements use geometry 8; final candidate additionally checks actual sidebar resize and outside-click editor dismissal
Native runtime 7 is unchanged; no repeated GPU comparison was needed for this geometry/controller change
